---
title: Start a deck
---

## Run the public example

Install [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/) and
[Just](https://just.systems/man/en/), then clone the project:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/rahuldave/htmpres.git
cd htmpres
just example
```

Open `decks/example/index.html` for the audience, or
`decks/example/presenter.html` for slides with speaker notes. Both are direct
HTML from the htmpres renderer. Quarto's bundled Pandoc handles Markdown; the
presentation does not use Reveal.js.

## Create your own

```sh
quarto run scripts/htmpres.ts deck new decks/my-talk --theme nocturne
quarto run scripts/htmpres.ts serve decks/my-talk/index.qmd --watch
```

The server rerenders after source or stylesheet changes; refresh the browser to
see the result. Edit `index.qmd` for
content, `source.css` for layout, and `assets/` for local media. Stop the preview
with Ctrl+C. See the [CLI guide](authoring-cli.md) for preview options.

Use `##` for each slide and a notes block for its cues:

````markdown
## A useful claim

Evidence your audience can see.

::: notes
Explain the evidence, then pause for a question.
:::
````

Notes are included in presenter HTML and removed from audience HTML. The source
and presenter download contain those notes; share the audience output when cues
should stay private. The two windows navigate independently.

## Choose a theme

```yaml
deck:
  css: source.css
  theme: nocturne
  color-mode: auto
```

Imported themes support `light`, `dark` and `auto`. See the
[theme catalog](themes.md) or [compare the example](compare.qmd).

## Build this documentation

Install [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/) as well as
Quarto and Just. The build runs pinned **SmallDocs 0.5.5** in an isolated tool
environment; the first build may need network access.

```sh
just docs
just docs-serve 8770
```

`just docs` renders the example, generates all comparison variants, checks the
SmallDocs sources and writes `docs/_site/`. `just docs-serve` serves the site and
reloads documentation edits. For changes to the example or comparison generator,
rerun `just docs` first. To use your own installed SmallDocs executable, set
`SMALLDOCS_BIN` to its path.

`just check` verifies the renderer, example, site and local links. `just
compat-check` also checks the optional Node renderer. Node is not needed for
the default build.
